name: Lomita City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Tuesday, April 06, 2021 - 06:00 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
AGENDA
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
TUESDAY, APRIL 6, 2021
6:00 P.M.
24300 NARBONNE, AVENUE, LOMITA CA, 90717
PURSUANT TO EXECUTIVE ORDER N-29-20 ISSUED BY GOVERNER NEWSOM ON MARCH 17, 2020, THE PUBLIC AND COUNCIL MAY PARTICIPATE IN THIS MEETING VIA TELECONFERENCE USING THE ZOOM PLATFORM.
Public comment will be accepted via email to ccpubliccomments@lomitacity.com prior to the meeting and before the close of oral communications. All comments will be read into the record.
The public may also participate in the meeting via a computer or smart device by logging into ZOOM at the following link: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/83721371561
You may enter your name when prompted do so. If you wish to provide public comment at either the beginning of the meeting or for a particular item, you may either (a) contact the City Clerk's Office before the meeting and provide your name or (b) utilize the "raise hand" option located under the participants name. Once you click on this option you will be in the rotation to make a public comment.
Please note, if you do not have the audio feature on your device you will need to call (669) 900-6833 and enter ZOOM Meeting ID: 837 2137 1561 then press pound (#). When prompted to enter the participation ID number press pound (#) again. To make a public comment enter "*9". The Clerk's office will be notified, and you will be announced to make a public comment.
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution via the City of Lomita website or by contacting the Deputy City Clerk at l.abbott@lomitacity.com.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at (310) 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the City to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
This meeting will be conducted in compliance with CDC guidelines and applicable orders of the Los Angeles County Health Officer.
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a)
Call Meeting to Order
b)
Flag Salute
c)
Invocation ? Mayor Pro Tem Segawa
d)
Roll Call
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
* PROCLAMATION RECOGNIZING APRIL 2021 AS DONATE LIFE MONTH PRESENTED TO JIM AND CARRIE HOLLAND, ONE LEGACY AMBASSADORS FOR THE CITY OF LOMITA
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five-minute time limit per person has been established. Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibits the Council from discussing or taking action on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council comments; however, items which are not on the agenda will be limited to Council reports, announcements, requests for clarification or factual information, or placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
6.
CITY MANAGER’S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Council Member or staff.
RECOMMENDED ACTION: That Consent Calendar Items 7 a-j be approved.
a.
Motion to Waive Full Reading of Ordinances and that they be Read in Title Only
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Approve Motion.
b.
Minutes of the Special City Council Meetings of March 1, 2021, and March 30, 2021
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Approve Minutes.
Item 7b
c.
Warrants/Payroll Register
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Approve and File Warrants/Payroll Register.
Item 7c
d.
Proclamation Recognizing April 2021 as Donate Life Month
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Adopt Proclamation.
Item 7d
e.
Proclamation Recognizing April 30, 2021, as Arbor Day.
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Adopt Proclamation.
Item 7e
f.
Ordinance No. 821 – An Ordinance Amending the Contract between the Board of Administration of the California Public Employees’ Retirement System (CalPERS) and the City of Lomita (Second Reading)
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Adopt Ordinance No. 821, authorizing an Amendment to the Contract between the City of Lomita and the Board of Administration of the California Public Employees’ Retirement System to increase Cost-Sharing from 0.5% to 1% Pursuant to Government Code Section 20516
ORDINANCE NO. 821 - AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LOMITA, CALIFORNIA, AUTHORIZING AN AMENDMENT TO THE CONTRACT BETWEEN THE CITY OF LOMITA AND THE BOARD OF ADMINISTRATION OF THE CALIFORNIA PUBLIC EMPLOYEES’ RETIREMENT SYSTEM TO ADD COST-SHARING PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE SECTION 20516
Item 7f
g.
Changes to Parking on Oak Street and Pacific Coast Highway
RECOMMENDED ACTION: 1) Remove R28 (CA) signs (NO PARKING, 7 A.M. - 9 A.M., MON – FRI) from the east side of Oak Street between Pacific Coast Highway and the first driveway south of Pacific Coast Highway; and 2) Install 25 feet of red curb on the east side of Oak Street between the south crosswalk and a point 25 feet southerly.
Item 7g
h.
Installation of Speed Limit Signs on Pennsylvania Avenue and on Saddle View Drive
RECOMMENDED ACTION: 1) Install a “SPEED LIMIT 25” sign (R2-1 (25)) on west side of Pennsylvania Avenue at a point 120 feet south of the south curb line of Pacific Coast Highway; 2) Install a “SPEED LIMIT 25” sign (R2-1 (25)) on east side of Pennsylvania Avenue near Chapman Street; and 3) Install a “SPEED LIMIT 25” sign (R2-1 (25)) on east side of Saddle View Drive at the north curb line of Chapman Street.
Item 7h
i.
Professional Services Agreement with MBF Consulting, Inc. for Engineering and Survey Services for the Harbor Hills Direct Metering Project
RECOMMENDED ACTION: 1) Approve a Professional Services Agreement with MBF Consulting, Inc. for Engineering and Survey Services for the Harbor Hills Development in the amount of 14,360.00 plus a 20% contingency amount of $2,872.00; and 2) Authorize the City Manager and City Clerk to execute the Agreement; and 3) Increase the Harbor Hills Direct Metering Project budget by $7,732 from the Water Capital Fund.
Item 7i
j.
2021 Strategic Plan & Goal Setting Final Report
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Receive and file the report and adopt the 2021 Goals.
Item 7j
SCHEDULED ITEMS
8.
DISCUSSION AND CONSIDERATION OF A LOS ANGELES COUNTY SHERIFF’S DEPARTMENT (LASD) PROPOSAL FOR 2021 SUPPLEMENTAL TRAFFIC ENFORCEMENT
Presented by Carla Dillon, Public Works Director
RECOMMENDED ACTION: 1) Approve the Los Angeles County Sheriff’s Department (LASD) Proposal for 2021 Supplemental Traffic Enforcement for $50,000; and 2) Authorize the City Manager to direct LASD to provide this Supplemental Service.
Item SCH 8
9.
DISCUSSION AND CONSIDERATION TO SCHEDULE A DATE AND TIME FOR THE FY 2021-2022 BUDGET WORKSHOP AND FY 2021-2022 BUDGET PUBLIC HEARING
Presented by Susan Kamada, Administrative Services Director
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Select one of the following dates for the FY 2021-2022 Budget Workshop:
Monday, May 10, 2021, at 4:00 p.m.
Tuesday, May 11, 2021, at 4:00 p.m.
Wednesday, May 12, 2021, at 4:00 p.m.
Thursday, May 13, 2021, at 4:00 p.m.
Item SCH 9
PUBLIC HEARINGS
10.
DISCUSSION AND CONSIDERATION TO INTRODUCE ZONE TEXT AMENDMENT NO. 2021-01 TO PERMIT A "BREWPUB" WITHIN THE COMMERCIAL RETAIL ZONE (C-R) SUBJECT TO A CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT (First Reading)
Presented by Greg Kapovich, Community and Economic Development Director
RECOMMENDED ACTION: After opening the public hearing, introduce on first reading an ordinance for Zone Text Amendment No. 2021-01 amending Lomita Municipal Code Section 11-1.48.04 to permit a "Brewpub" within the Commercial Retail zone (C-R) subject to a conditional use permit.
ORDINANCE NO. 822 - AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LOMITA, CALIFORNIA, APPROVING ZONE TEXT AMENDMENT 2021-01 AMENDING SECTION 11-1.48.04(A) TO PERMIT A "BREWPUB" WITHIN THE COMMERCIAL RETAIL (C-R) ZONE SUBJECT TO A CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT, AND FINDING THE SAME EXEMPT FROM CEQA
Item PH 10
11.
ADJOURNMENT The next regular meeting of the Lomita City Council will be held on Tuesday, April 20, 2021, at 6:00 p.m.
I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting at the following locations: Lomita City Hall lobby and outside bulletin board, Lomita Parks and Recreation, and uploaded to the City of Lomita website http://www.lomita.com/cityhall/city_agendas/.
